sources.title: Osmania University Brochure 2026
sources.reuseConditions: Official University-hosted brochure; no explicit reuse licence established. Only individually stated degree titles and named facilities are summarized with direct attribution and page locators. No tables, prose, metrics, eligibility, fees, or outcome claims are reproduced; confirm current intake because no applicable admission year is stated.
evidenceLocations: Page 26, College of Engineering, Programs Offered: Bachelor of Engineering in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Bio-Medical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, and Mining Engineering.
Page 22, Main Campus: campus description states that the main campus includes a central library and student hostels.
